dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler. How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Jade Chamber...

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: The Jade Chamber is where Lady Ningguang holds court. Here, she gathers information and makes important decisions.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: From here, there is no matter in Liyue, great or small, that she cannot oversee. Nor can any rumor escape our ears or eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Of course, we continued working for Lady Ningguang during the period before the Jade Chamber's restoration, just as we always had... But it's good to be back.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, while you are Lady Ningguang's honored guest, we cannot disclose the intelligence gathered here to you. My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you tell me about Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang is one of the Liyue Qixing. She oversees all of Liyue and its trade.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: You must forgive me for not being able to say more.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: But considering how well the two of you get along... You might simply be able to ask her if you desire answers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have the utmost respect for Lady Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Hmm... You are, indeed, a rare and honest sort — cut from a different cloth from those honey-tongued merchants, greedy for the smallest scrap of information.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: The path to riches is actually quite simple. I've spent a lot of time by Lady Ningguang's side, and learned some... secrets, here and there.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: How about this: Here are some nuggets of wisdom on the subject of "gold." It's my own personal guidance rather than Lady Ningguang's per se, but maybe it will still be able to bring fortune and prosperity your way.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Welcome, is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Welcome, I am Lady Ningguang's secretary. You can call me Baixiao.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Farewell, and safe travels.
